  <section id="research">
    <h2>Research</h2>

    <article class="paper-card">
      <div class="pc-left">
        <h3 class="pc-title">Closing Pandora&rsquo;s IP Box: Real Effects of the Nexus Approach</h3>
        <span class="paper-meta">single-authored · under review · 2026 · <a href="https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=4837668">SSRN</a></span>
        <p class="pc-teaser">Exploiting the staggered adoption of the modified-nexus substance requirement across European IP Box regimes, I trace patenting, investment, and R&amp;D employment within multinational groups. Affiliates in IP Box countries raise domestic patent development by about 3%, alongside higher capital investment and R&amp;D employment. Non-IP Box sister affiliates show a corresponding <b>8% decline</b>, while MNE-level estimates are insignificant. This pattern is consistent with a <b>within-group reallocation</b> of innovative activity toward IP Box locations rather than net growth. <button class="abstract-toggle" id="abs-toggle" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="abs-full"><span class="lbl">Read full abstract</span> <span class="chev">&#9662;</span></button></p>
        <div class="abstract-full" id="abs-full">
          <p>To combat multinational firms&rsquo; tax avoidance, policymakers have taken three approaches: direct anti-avoidance rules, transparency mandates, and tax system changes that align corporate activity with cash tax benefits. The latter approach is little understood but has potentially meaningful economic effects beyond limiting tax avoidance. This study examines such a tax system change: the recent Nexus Approach mandated in the European Union to align tax incentives for innovation with firms&rsquo; real activity. I show that innovation output, investment, and the demand for research and development (R&amp;D) personnel increase in countries that offer preferential tax regimes for income from intellectual property (IP Box countries) after the nexus requirement is introduced. The effects are strongest among affiliates that, prior to the reform, engaged more extensively in IP-Box-related income shifting, had lower frictions to expanding domestic R&amp;D, or operated in countries with strong tax benefits and subsidy environments. This growth, however, comes at the expense of non-IP Box countries, as multinationals reallocate innovative activities and investments within their group.</p>
        </div>
        <a class="pc-link" href="https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=4837668">Read on SSRN &#8599;</a>

    <article class="paper-card" id="card-sun">
      <div class="pc-left">
        <h3 class="pc-title">Don&rsquo;t Fear the Sunlight: Tax Transparency and Multinational Investment in the Global South</h3>
        <span class="paper-meta">with Marcel Olbert · work in progress · 2026</span>
        <p class="pc-teaser">When a developing country joins the Country-by-Country Reporting (CbCR) information-exchange network, its tax authority gains access to multinationals&rsquo; global tax positions for the first time. We ask whether this transparency drives investment away, or whether, by making tax enforcement more predictable, it actually <b>attracts</b> it. Across bilateral, country, and firm-level designs, CbCR-scope firms expand their local presence, host tax revenue rises, and governance improves, especially where pre-reform corruption was high.</p>
        <a class="pc-link" href="mailto:matti.boie-wegener@uni-mannheim.de?subject=Working%20paper%20request%3A%20Don%27t%20Fear%20the%20Sunlight">Request working paper &#8599;</a>

    <article class="paper-card" id="card-arb">
      <div class="pc-left">
        <h3 class="pc-title">Do Transfer Pricing Arbitration Clauses Foster Profit Shifting and Foreign Direct Investment?</h3>
        <span class="paper-meta">with Andreas Oestreicher · work in progress · 2025</span>
        <p class="pc-teaser">Using a stacked difference-in-differences design, we study how <b>arbitration clauses in double taxation treaties</b> reshape multinational behavior. The clauses significantly affect profit shifting and raise trade value-added at low-taxed affiliates, yet <b>weaken FDI inflows</b> into those affiliates and increase profit distributions — a tension between paper profits and real investment.</p>
        <a class="pc-link" href="mailto:matti.boie-wegener@uni-mannheim.de?subject=Working%20paper%20request%3A%20Transfer%20Pricing%20Arbitration">Request working paper &#8599;</a>
      </div>

  <section id="teaching">
    <h2>Teaching</h2>
    <p>I teach corporate taxation and empirical tax research, with an emphasis on institutional knowledge and empirical research skills and an applied, policy-relevant focus.</p>
    <p class="teach-level">Bachelor</p>
    <div class="teach">
      <div class="course"><span class="course-name">Company Taxes I</span><span class="course-meta">exercise class · 2021–23</span></div>
      <div class="course"><span class="course-name">Seminar on the Determination of Income</span><span class="course-meta">supervision</span></div>
      <div class="course"><span class="course-name">Workshop on Academic Writing and Research Methods</span><span class="course-meta">instructor · 2021–23</span></div>
      <div class="course"><span class="course-name">Bachelor&rsquo;s theses</span><span class="course-meta">supervision</span></div>
    </div>
    <p class="teach-level">Master</p>
    <div class="teach">
      <div class="course"><span class="course-name">Seminar on Company Taxation</span><span class="course-meta">supervision</span></div>
      <div class="course"><span class="course-name">Seminar on Empirical Tax Research</span><span class="course-meta">instructor · 2025</span></div>
      <div class="course"><span class="course-name">Workshop on Academic Writing and Research Methods</span><span class="course-meta">instructor</span></div>
      <div class="course"><span class="course-name">Master&rsquo;s theses</span><span class="course-meta">supervision</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="teach-stats">
      <div class="stat"><span class="stat-n">26+</span><span class="stat-l">bachelor&rsquo;s &amp; master&rsquo;s theses supervised</span></div>
      <div class="stat"><span class="stat-n">20+</span><span class="stat-l">seminar papers · company taxation</span></div>
      <div class="stat"><span class="stat-n">12+</span><span class="stat-l">seminar papers · income determination</span></div>

</div>

<script>
  (function(){
    var reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

    /* nav scroll-spy: highlight the section currently in view */
    (function(){
      var navA = {};
      document.querySelectorAll('.topnav nav a').forEach(function(a){ navA[a.getAttribute('href')] = a; });
      var secs = ['top','news','research','teaching'].map(function(id){ return document.getElementById(id); }).filter(Boolean);
      if(!secs.length) return;
      var spy = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
        entries.forEach(function(e){
          if(!e.isIntersecting) return;
          var a = navA['#'+e.target.id]; if(!a) return;
          Object.keys(navA).forEach(function(k){ navA[k].classList.toggle('on', navA[k]===a); });
        });
      }, { rootMargin: '-12% 0px -80% 0px', threshold: 0 });
      secs.forEach(function(s){ spy.observe(s); });
    })();
    function fmtN(v, dec){ dec=dec||0; var s=v>0?'+':(v<0?'−':''); var a=Math.abs(v); return s+(dec? a.toFixed(dec) : Math.round(a)); }
    function fmt(v){ return fmtN(v,0); }
    function draw(el, dur, delay){ if(!el) return; if(reduce){ el.style.strokeDashoffset='0'; return; }
      el.style.transition='none'; el.style.strokeDashoffset='1'; void el.getBoundingClientRect();
      el.style.transition='stroke-dashoffset '+dur+'ms ease '+(delay||0)+'ms'; el.style.strokeDashoffset='0'; }
    function fade(el, dur, delay){ if(!el) return; if(reduce){ el.style.opacity='1'; return; }
      el.style.transition='none'; el.style.opacity='0'; void el.getBoundingClientRect();
      el.style.transition='opacity '+dur+'ms ease '+(delay||0)+'ms'; el.style.opacity='1'; }
    function countTo(el, target, dur, cb, dec){ dec=dec||0; var start=null;
      function step(ts){ if(start===null) start=ts; var p=Math.min((ts-start)/dur,1); var e=1-Math.pow(1-p,3);
        el.textContent=fmtN(target*e,dec); if(p<1){ requestAnimationFrame(step); } else { el.textContent=fmtN(target,dec); if(cb) cb(); } }
      requestAnimationFrame(step); }
    function onView(el, cb){ if(!el) return; if('IntersectionObserver' in window){
        var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){ es.forEach(function(e){ if(e.isIntersecting) cb(); }); }, {threshold:0.35}); io.observe(el);
      } else { cb(); } }

    /* ---- Card 1: Nexus ---- */
    var tabReloc=document.getElementById('tab-reloc'), tabEvent=document.getElementById('tab-event');
    var viewReloc=document.getElementById('view-reloc'), viewEvent=document.getElementById('view-event');
    var esAnim=viewEvent.querySelectorAll('.es-anim'), esPath=document.getElementById('es-path');
    var numLeft=document.getElementById('num-left'), numRight=document.getElementById('num-right');
    var caretLeft=document.getElementById('caret-left'), caretRight=document.getElementById('caret-right');
    var coefNums=document.querySelectorAll('#fig-nexus .cnum');
    var legendReloc=document.getElementById('legend-reloc'), legendEvent=document.getElementById('legend-event');
    function playCoefs(){ coefNums.forEach(function(el){ var to=parseFloat(el.getAttribute('data-to'));
      if(reduce){ el.textContent=fmt(to); return; } el.textContent='0'; countTo(el,to,700); }); }
    function playReloc(){ if(reduce){ numLeft.textContent=fmt(3); numRight.textContent=fmt(-8); caretLeft.style.opacity=1; caretRight.style.opacity=1; playCoefs(); return; }
      numLeft.textContent='0'; numRight.textContent='0'; caretLeft.style.opacity=0; caretRight.style.opacity=0;
      coefNums.forEach(function(el){ el.textContent='0'; }); void viewReloc.getBoundingClientRect();
      caretRight.style.opacity=1; countTo(numRight,-8,750,function(){ setTimeout(function(){ caretLeft.style.opacity=1; countTo(numLeft,3,750,function(){ playCoefs(); }); },250); }); }
    function playEvent(){ coefNums.forEach(function(el){ el.textContent=fmt(parseFloat(el.getAttribute('data-to'))); }); if(reduce) return;
      draw(esPath,1000,0); esAnim.forEach(function(g,i){ fade(g,350,i*90); }); }
    function playNexus(){ if(viewReloc.classList.contains('active')) playReloc(); else playEvent(); }
    function show(m){ var r=m==='reloc'; tabReloc.classList.toggle('on',r); tabEvent.classList.toggle('on',!r);
      tabReloc.setAttribute('aria-selected',r); tabEvent.setAttribute('aria-selected',!r);
      viewReloc.classList.toggle('active',r); viewEvent.classList.toggle('active',!r);
      legendReloc.style.display=r?'flex':'none'; legendEvent.style.display=r?'none':'flex'; playNexus(); }
    tabReloc.addEventListener('click',function(){ show('reloc'); }); tabEvent.addEventListener('click',function(){ show('event'); });
    document.getElementById('replay').addEventListener('click', playNexus);
    var absToggle=document.getElementById('abs-toggle'), absFull=document.getElementById('abs-full');
    absToggle.addEventListener('click',function(){ var o=absFull.classList.toggle('open'); absToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded',o);
      absToggle.querySelector('.lbl').textContent=o?'Hide full abstract':'Read full abstract'; });
    onView(document.getElementById('fig-nexus'), playNexus);

    /* ---- Card 2: Arbitration ---- */
    onView(document.getElementById('fig-arb'), function(){ draw(document.getElementById('arb-up'),900,0); fade(document.getElementById('arb-dn'),700,350); });

    /* ---- Card 3: Sunlight (setting + firm-level OLS event study) ---- */
    var tabSM=document.getElementById('tab-sm'), tabSE=document.getElementById('tab-se');
    var viewSM=document.getElementById('view-sm'), viewSE=document.getElementById('view-se');
    var legSM=document.getElementById('leg-sm'), legSE=document.getElementById('leg-se');
    var d0=document.getElementById('doc0'), d1=document.getElementById('doc1'), d2=document.getElementById('doc2');
    var hostA=document.getElementById('host-a'), hostB=document.getElementById('host-b');
    var sCoef=document.querySelectorAll('#fig-sun .scnum');
    var esPathSun=document.getElementById('es-path-sun');
    var esAnimSun=document.querySelectorAll('#view-se .es-anim');
    function setT(el,x,y){ el.style.transform='translate('+x+'px,'+y+'px)'; }
    function sunCoefsFinal(){ sCoef.forEach(function(el){ el.textContent=fmtN(parseFloat(el.getAttribute('data-to')), parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-dec'),10)||0); }); }
    function playSunCoefs(){ sCoef.forEach(function(el){ var to=parseFloat(el.getAttribute('data-to')), dec=parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-dec'),10)||0;
      if(reduce){ el.textContent=fmtN(to,dec); return; } el.textContent=fmtN(0,dec); countTo(el,to,750,null,dec); }); }
    function playSunMech(){
      if(reduce){ hostA.classList.add('net'); hostB.classList.add('net'); d0.style.opacity=0;
        setT(d1,118,140); setT(d2,218,140); d1.style.opacity=1; d2.style.opacity=1; playSunCoefs(); return; }
      hostA.classList.remove('net'); hostB.classList.remove('net');
      [d0,d1,d2].forEach(function(d){ d.style.transition='none'; d.style.opacity='0'; });
      setT(d0,40,33); setT(d1,258,48); setT(d2,258,48);
      sCoef.forEach(function(el){ var dec=parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-dec'),10)||0; el.textContent=fmtN(0,dec); });
      void viewSM.getBoundingClientRect();
      d0.style.transition='transform .8s ease, opacity .3s ease'; d0.style.opacity='1'; setT(d0,250,33);
      setTimeout(function(){ d0.style.opacity='0';
        d1.style.transition='transform .9s ease, opacity .3s ease'; d1.style.opacity='1'; setT(d1,118,140);
        d2.style.transition='transform .9s ease, opacity .3s ease'; d2.style.opacity='1'; setT(d2,218,140); }, 900);
      setTimeout(function(){ hostA.classList.add('net'); hostB.classList.add('net');
        d1.style.opacity='0'; d2.style.opacity='0'; playSunCoefs(); }, 1850);
    }
    function playSunEs(){ sunCoefsFinal(); if(reduce) return; draw(esPathSun,1000,0); esAnimSun.forEach(function(g,i){ fade(g,350,i*60); }); }
    function playSunActive(){ if(viewSM.classList.contains('active')){ playSunMech(); } else { playSunEs(); } }
    function showSun(mode){ var m=mode==='mech'; tabSM.classList.toggle('on',m); tabSE.classList.toggle('on',!m);
      tabSM.setAttribute('aria-selected',m); tabSE.setAttribute('aria-selected',!m);
      viewSM.classList.toggle('active',m); viewSE.classList.toggle('active',!m);
      legSM.style.display=m?'flex':'none'; legSE.style.display=m?'none':'flex'; playSunActive(); }
    tabSM.addEventListener('click', function(){ showSun('mech'); });
    tabSE.addEventListener('click', function(){ showSun('es'); });
    document.getElementById('replay-sun').addEventListener('click', playSunActive);
    onView(document.getElementById('fig-sun'), playSunActive);
  })();
</script>
